verdict.rationale: Jan is an AI assistant app, so AI-generated output is its core function. The docs say its agents can read files and work on tasks autonomously using files, commands and web research (jan-docs-13, jan-docs-14). They can also reach other data sources through MCP (jan-gh-5, jan-docs-8) and use custom assistants (jan-gh-3, jan-docs-12). Deriving insights from the user's own data is only implied through file reading and tool access, not documented as a dedicated feature. missing for 10: documented document/knowledge-base chat or RAG over user data, proactive suggestions or insight surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of file-based analysis.
